activity_summary: The gunner called a doubt disloyalty to the voyage and to the Queen. Alice put him out and sent the chart with him. You had doubted the count of ships, not a blessing you had not seen. You stayed. You did not follow him, and you did not write a truer number.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said he had doubted the count, and stayed.

entities.name: Alice Brambleby
entities.context: Put the man out, chart and all, and kept the sixpence supper.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Distinguished a doubt from a sin.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Kept the respectful question, and let the man leave.

facets.activity: Saw the chart go out the door
